rules.statement: Privileged workflows MUST isolate untrusted code and use least-privilege short-lived access where available.

rules.statement: Deployable artifacts MUST be environment-agnostic; all environment-specific values MUST be supplied at runtime through the environment or platform secret store.
rules.verification: Image inspection and fly.toml/secrets review per environment
rules.applies_when: an application reads any setting that differs between environments or must stay out of source control

rules.statement: Required configuration MUST be validated at startup, and secrets MUST NOT appear in images, committed files, browser bundles, or logs.
rules.verification: Startup failure test, bundle grep, secret scan in CI
rules.applies_when: an application reads any setting that differs between environments or must stay out of source control

rules.statement: Feature flags MUST have an owner, purpose, default, and removal condition, and MUST be read through one typed access path.
rules.verification: Flag inventory review and code search
rules.applies_when: an application reads any setting that differs between environments or must stay out of source control

rules.statement: Production services MUST have a named primary responder, a fallback, and documented severity levels with response and communication targets.
rules.verification: On-call record and severity table in the service runbook
rules.applies_when: a production service is degraded, unavailable, leaking data, or at imminent risk

rules.statement: Incidents MUST be recorded with a timeline, actions taken, and user impact from declaration to close, and recovery MUST prefer tested rollback over live debugging.
rules.verification: Incident issue review and rollback exercise evidence
rules.applies_when: a production service is degraded, unavailable, leaking data, or at imminent risk

rules.statement: SEV1 and SEV2 incidents MUST produce a blameless postmortem within five working days with owned, tracked action items.
rules.verification: Postmortem document and linked issues
rules.applies_when: a production service is degraded, unavailable, leaking data, or at imminent risk

rules.statement: Teams MUST track recurring operational toil per service and MUST automate, eliminate, or explicitly accept each recurring item with an owner and review date.
rules.verification: Toil list review and automation evidence
rules.applies_when: a service runs in production and someone is expected to respond when it misbehaves

rules.statement: Every stateful service MUST be assigned a criticality tier with recorded RPO and RTO targets and a backup cadence that can meet them.
rules.verification: Tier record in the service runbook and backup job configuration
rules.applies_when: a service owns state that users or the business would miss if it were lost

rules.statement: Backups MUST be restored into an isolated environment on the tier's drill cadence, with measured RPO/RTO and discrepancies recorded.
rules.verification: Dated drill evidence in the runbook
rules.applies_when: a service owns state that users or the business would miss if it were lost

rules.statement: Tier 1 and tier 2 data MUST have an encrypted copy outside the primary hosting platform and account, with monitored backup jobs.
rules.verification: Off-platform storage listing and job alert history
rules.applies_when: a service owns state that users or the business would miss if it were lost
